announcements.headline: Completion of Russia Hygiene Business Divestment
announcements.insight: Finalizes the exit from a high-growth but geopolitically volatile market, allowing Reckitt to consolidate capital and focus on core Western markets amid rising input costs. This divestment removes execution risk and aligns with broader FMCG trends of retreating from Russia following the Ukraine invasion.
